title: @ElyseEA I work at "other university" in New Haven. Sometimes feels like our schools are 2,000 miles apart not two miles. So much disparity, sympathy
summary: @ElyseEA I work at "other university" in New Haven. Sometimes feels like our schools are 2,000 miles apart not two miles. So much disparity, sympathy for not getting that trip to Bali...not so much. My students see spring break as chance for extra shifts.
